changes_made.explanation: Normalized model name to standard format and cleaned up output description
No automatic metrics were used to evaluate the generated outputs (paraphrased transcripts)
Removed placeholder 'None' values since no LLMs were used as judges

guideline: Manual inspection to verify: (1) semantic content consistency between original and rephrased versions, (2) tone and sentiment consistency, (3) absence of offensive/unethical/inappropriate language, (4) preservation of personal details and identifiers

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated and normalized criteria to remove redundant/repeated items while maintaining all evaluation dimensions

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on depression detection using multimodal data, with NLG (paraphrase generation) being a secondary component used for data augmentation. The human evaluation was conducted only for quality verification of the augmented data, not for systematically evaluating generation quality. No automatic metrics were used to assess the generated paraphrases.
